note: The bots' looks and moments (docs/bots-app.md, 'Looks and moments'). Data the apps draw and play: change it, raise v by one, and the apps take it at their next start. tulmi/src/experience/bots/looks.ts checks every field; the apps' starter copy is generated from this file.

palm.note: An open hand, as if on the glass.

laptop.note: Side on: the base on the floor, the lid open toward him.

glasses.note: One great round frame, for one great eye.

w_hood_back.note: The hood's volume behind and above the head, its soft peak flopped back; the far side in shadow.

w_hood_front.note: The hood's cloth around his face (a ring: outer edge one way, the opening the other), the deep shadow inside it, the rolled edge catching the light, a fold under the chin.

w_poncho.note: A long undyed wool poncho, past the knees: the far side in shadow, drape folds, the light on the near shoulder, the hood's shadow at the collar, a woven hem band and fringe.

s_cloak.note: A long midnight cloak behind him, shoulders to the ground and pooling a little; folds; light on the edges.

s_cowl.note: The cloak's hood, down: a deep roll of cloth around the back of his neck.

s_cape.note: The shoulder cape, to the elbows, open down the middle, held by a plain wooden toggle.

staff_lantern.note: A walking staff, a crook at its top, a lit lantern hanging from it. Held a third of the way down.

spyglass.note: A brass spyglass with ink rings, held forward of his face, the tube running back to his eye.

campfire.note: A small fire: two crossed logs, stones, the embers' glow. The flames are emitted.

mote.note: A speck of light, a spark, a firefly.

glowmote.note: A firefly: a lit speck in its own small glow.

crystal_dim.note: The crystal ball, quiet. Its centre sits 0.12 above the hand, where the mist turns.

crystal_bright.note: The crystal ball, lit from inside.

cardfan.note: Three cards fanned in the hand, plain backs with a border.

card.note: One card, its plain back to us.

card_up.note: The drawn card, held up, larger: paper, a border, a soft wash of his colour.

book.note: A heavy old book, open, held in both hands.

page.note: A page in the air as it turns.

envelope.note: A letter, its back to us: paper, the flap folded down, a round seal in the bot's colour.

mailbag.note: A postie's satchel at his back: the bag, its flap's edge, a buckle, and a letter peeking out of it.

stamper.note: A rubber stamp: a round wooden knob, its neck, a dark block, the rubber inked in the bot's colour.

postmark.note: A postmark, left in the air where the stamp came down: two rings and three wavy lines, in his colour.

blip.label: Blip
blip.note: Every bot's look before looks were data, exactly. Each kind wears its own copy (below), so one can change alone.

postie.label: The postie (a navy cap, a postal-red satchel, a letter peeking out of it)

pond.label: A dotted pond; a fish leaps; taps ring it; his voice ripples it

els.r: 0.018*open*(1 - smooth(1.0, 1.3, d))*(0.6 + 0.4*crest(d*6 - t*3) + 0.8*level*crest(d*9 - t*7) + 1.2*(tapt < 1.6)*crest((hypot(qx - tapx, qy - tapy) - tapt*1.4)*8))

tracks.note: the bounce: down on every beat
a sway and a shuffle, two beats each way
arms: up in turn, one each beat
a held breath: still, eyes wide
pfft: a jolt, a puff out of the back, the cloth ripples, the others lean away
the guilty look round: left, right, left
and whistling, hands behind his back
the build-up: head back, eyes closing, mouth opening, three catches of breath
CHOO: head and spray forward, knocked back a step
after: dazed, a shake of the head, a sniff
a yawn: arms up, head back, mouth wide
he sits, and nods off
asleep: breathing, a nod, z's, a snore
now and then a start, and back to sleep
a drop: wide eyes on it, an oops, a shrug
the spin: arms out, turning faster
after: stars round his head, spiral eyes, a wobble
a sigh
with another bot near: both go to the side between them and slap hands
alone: one to the screen, to you
he stays at it (leaning in would walk him off)
a panicked glance at you
done: a wipe of the brow, and a sigh
between hiccups: a hand to his mouth, embarrassed
hic: a jolt up, wide eyes, a bubble

w.lookup.label: Looks up from under his hood

tracks.note: bowed into his hood; the head lifts, he finds you, a slow blink, and he sinks back into it
a dip first, then the hand comes out at the poncho's side and waves

w.rain.label: Caught in the rain, then shakes it off

tracks.note: rain comes down on him; he hunches into the hood
it stops; a breath, and the shake

w.walk.label: Walks with his staff and lantern

tracks.note: he stops, lifts the lantern and looks out into the dark

w.light.label: Lights his lantern, then blows it out

tracks.note: a match from the other hand, struck: a spray of sparks
it catches: the lantern lit, a little hop
he blows it out

w.spyglass.label: Spots something in the sky and points

tracks.note: there: he stops, leans in
the glass comes down and he points it out

w.campfire.label: Warms his hands; a spark makes him jump

tracks.note: a big spark pops at him
and he laughs at himself

s.wrap.label: A cold breath; he pulls his cape close

s.crystal.label: The crystal ball wakes and shows him

tracks.note: his other hand circles over it; mist turns inside
it wakes
and he sees it
three cards, laid out on the air
he draws one and holds it up

s.book.label: Leafs through an old book until he finds it

tracks.note: pages fly
there it is
and he looks up at you, pleased

m.sort.label: Catches the letters as they drop in, and files each in his bag

tracks.note: letter 1: it drops in from above
letter 2: it drops in from above
letter 3: it drops in from above

m.catch.label: A letter flies in; he catches it, reads who it is from, and tucks it in his bag

tracks.note: it comes in from up behind him, spinning
caught: a little bounce
into the bag at his back, and a pat on it

m.stamp.label: Stamps a letter twice, then sends it off with a wave

tracks.note: up, and down hard
held up, then off it goes
